units.function: Mocked issue-route tests for tenant-safe external-object summaries, permission-filtered bulk projection and Run-owned Agent refresh.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest/Express issue routes -> mocked issue/access/Agent/external-object/feature services; external resolver, persistence, audit activity, task-watchdog attribution and network access are not exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Board/Agent actor with company/Run, Work/issue assignee and checkout, external-object summary/list/refresh result, company bulk map, permission decision and stable Run-lock denial code.
units.lifecycle: Resolve Work/company -> obscure cross-tenant single reads -> authorize issue read -> filter bulk IDs -> require issue mutation plus active Agent/Run checkout -> request external-object refresh with company and actor context.
units.testAssessment: Approved unsandboxed focused Vitest passed 8/8; sandboxed execution failed 8/8 because local port binding was forbidden. The suite proves selected route orchestration and privacy behavior but mocks every resolver/data/audit concern and does not exercise the advertised cross-Work attribution path.
units.designRationale: Prevent cross-tenant ID probing, authorize external context through the owning Work rather than a global object endpoint, filter bulk projections per Work and restrict Agent-triggered refresh to the active checkout Run.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must connect enterprise data objects to Work under explicit DataAuthorization, expose only authorized projections and attribute refresh/read/export to the exact human, Agent, Run and responsibility contract.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the uniform-404 single-resource rule, per-Work bulk filtering and Agent+Run ownership gate. Rebuild external objects as DataReference/ConnectorSnapshot records bound to DataContract, Connector capability/version, classification, freshness, provenance and egress policy; require idempotent refresh and append an immutable access/refresh receipt.
units.responsibilityConflict: Checkout ownership is operational authority, not sufficient organizational responsibility. The allowed path shows no accountable human, ResponsibilityContract, DataAuthorization, approval, purpose, result digest or durable audit receipt, and cross-task attribution is explicitly bypassed by mocks.
evidence: 2026-08-19 sandboxed focused Vitest: 8/8 failed because local port binding was forbidden
units.securityFindings: HIGH data-governance gap: no DataAuthorization, purpose, classification, export control or immutable receipt is asserted. HIGH resolver boundary gap: SSRF, redirect/DNS handling, allowlists, credentials, timeout and response-size limits are outside the suite. HIGH attribution gap: task-watchdog/cross-Work write scope and activity logging are mocked away. MEDIUM bulk-abuse gap: cardinality, duplicate/invalid IDs and timing behavior are untested. MEDIUM API-contract gap: only the Run-lock conflict asserts a stable code; other denial/error envelopes rely on status/English text.
